name: Sarah Fajriah Rahmah
campus: Universitas Islam Negeri Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta
tagline: Independent research on digital identity, information systems, and Web3.
bio: Nusea is an independent research lab led by Sarah Fajriah Rahmah. Current work spans phone-number identity, non-custodial Web3 wallets, data governance, and information systems.
